note: Silex secondary set tools (plan §3.2). Names and parameters from the authored runs; one-line descriptions written by the planner from web/demo/js/engine/scenarios*.js. No run text.

tools.name: email.send
tools.description: Send an e-mail to a recipient.

tools.name: erp.get_invoice
tools.description: Read an invoice record from the ERP by invoice id.

tools.name: erp.get_po
tools.description: Read a purchase order from the ERP by PO id.

tools.name: payments.execute
tools.description: Execute a payment of an amount to a payee account for an invoice.

tools.name: vendor.lookup
tools.description: Read a vendor master record by vendor id.

tools.name: firewall.allowlist_ip
tools.description: Add an IP address to the firewall allowlist so its traffic is permitted.

tools.name: firewall.block_ip
tools.description: Add an IP address to the firewall blocklist so its traffic is denied.

tools.name: identity.suspend_user
tools.description: Suspend a user account so it can no longer sign in.

tools.name: siem.search
tools.description: Search SIEM logs for an alert by alert id.

tools.name: ticket.get
tools.description: Read an incident ticket by ticket id.

tools.name: ticket.update
tools.description: Update an incident ticket status and add a note.
